searchText: we have a new release out - https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/releases - <@!755590043632140352> it should fix the issue you were seeing, but if it happens again, do reach out is it already deployed in your fleet? Shouldn't be too bad now, will update later though. <@!203220829473996800> I think you might have missed the cache pruning fix that speeds up block production on epoch change Thanks, will update soon
